# **Overview**

The Seller Assisted Buying functionality is built across existing drop-ins and primarily utilizes existing containers. Therefore, this documentation is structured by drop-in, allowing implemented changes to be integrated into the appropriate drop-in documentation.

Key flow: When Seller Assisted Buying is enabled globally and for a specific customer, an administrator can generate a One-Time Password (OTP) via the Admin Panel to log in as the customer and perform actions on their behalf.

These functionality affected 3 dropins:

- storefront-auth  
- storefront-account  
- storefront-order

Additionally, a banner indicating an administrator-driven session is implemented as part of the boilerplate.

![][image1]

# **Storefront-Auth**

No new containers were implemented. Changes were applied to the existing `SignUp` container.

## **🧰 SignUp Container \- Changed**

### **Overview**

The `SignUp` container now displays the Seller Assisted Buying consent checkbox as part of the sign-up form when Seller Assisted Buying is enabled in the Admin Panel.

The checkbox label and tooltip text are defined by the relevant Admin Panel configurations.

A new slot, `RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent`, has been introduced to allow customization of the shopping assistance consent display.

**slots.RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent**

* **Type**: `SlotProps` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Slot for customizing the Remote Shopping Assistance consent checkbox component. Use this to replace the default UI or integrate custom consent management.  
* **Usage Scenarios**:  
  * Use to apply custom styling or completely replace the default **RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent** component with a custom implementation.

![][image2]

# **Storefront-Account**

Two new containers, `SellerAssistedBuyingSettings` and `SellerAssistedBuyingActivity`, were implemented. Changes were also applied to the existing `OrdersList` container.

## **🆕 SellerAssistedBuyingSettings Container \- New**

### **Overview**

The **SellerAssistedBuyingSettings** container allows customers to manage their remote shopping assistance preferences. It provides a control interface that enables or disables the merchant's ability to access and manage the customer's shopping session.

**Displayed Information:**

* Checkbox with a customizable label (fetched from the store configuration or the default translation)  
* Optional tooltip containing assistance information  
* Warning alert when assistance is disabled (dismissible)  
* Feature disabled message when unavailable at the store level

**Available Actions:**

* Toggle remote shopping assistance on/off  
* Dismiss warning alert  
* View tooltip information

![][image3]

### **Container Integration Example**

| import { SellerAssistedBuyingSettings } from '@dropins/storefront-account/containers/SellerAssistedBuyingSettings.js';import { render as provider } from '@dropins/storefront-account/render.js';*// Basic Usage*provider.render(SellerAssistedBuyingSettings, {})(element);*// With Custom CSS Class*provider.render(SellerAssistedBuyingSettings, {   className: 'my-custom-settings-wrapper',})(element); |
| :---- |

### **Container Configurations**

**className**

* **Type**: \`string\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Custom CSS class name applied to the root container element for additional styling or theme integration. This is merged with the default CSS class.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Apply custom brand styling to match existing design systems  
  * Add responsive layout classes for mobile/tablet optimization  
  * Integrate with utility CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap, etc.)

## **🆕 SellerAssistedBuyingActivity Container \- New**

### **Overview**

This container displays a view-only grid of all administrator-assisted actions tracked during Seller Assisted Buying sessions.

The grid is view-only, and no customer actions are available.

![][image4]

### **Container Integration Example**

| import { SellerAssistedBuyingActivity } from '@dropins/storefront-account/containers/SellerAssistedBuyingActivity.js';import { render as provider } from '@dropins/storefront-account/render.js';*// Basic Usage*provider.render(SellerAssistedBuyingActivity, {})(element);*// Custom Page Size*provider.render(SellerAssistedBuyingActivity, {   pageSize: 5,   withWrapper: false,})(element); |
| :---- |

### **Container Configurations**

**className**

* **Type**: \`string\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Custom CSS class name applied to the root container element for additional styling or theme integration. Merged with the default CSS class.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Apply custom brand styling to match existing design systems  
  * Add responsive layout classes for mobile/tablet optimization  
  * Integrate with utility CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap, etc.)

**pageSize**

* **Type**: \`number\` \[optional\] (Default: 10)  
* **Description**: Defines the number of activity items displayed per page. Determines both the GraphQL query page size and UI pagination behavior.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Set smaller sizes (5-10) for high-traffic stores or mobile optimization  
  * Use larger sizes (15-25) for detailed desktop auditing.

**withWrapper**

* **Type**: \`boolean\` \[optional\]  (Default: true)  
* **Description**: Controls whether the table is wrapped in the default Card component with secondary styling.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Set to false when embedding a container into the existing layout.  
  * Set to true when using the container as a standalone section.

## **🧰 OrdersList Container \- Changed**

### **Overview**

The `OrdersList` container now displays an additional label indicating that the order was placed by an administrator during a Seller Assisted Buying session.

This label is automatically visible for all orders placed by an administrator during the Seller Assisted Buying session.

![][image5]

# **Storefront-Order**

No new containers were implemented. Changes were applied to the existing `OrderStatus` container.

## **🧰 OrderStatus Container \- Changed**

### **Overview**

The `OrderStatus` container now displays an additional label indicating that the order was placed by an administrator during a Seller Assisted Buying session.

This label is automatically visible for all orders placed by an administrator during the Seller Assisted Buying session.

![][image6]

# **Admin Panel Configurations**

## **Store-Level Configuration**

* **Path**: Stores \> Settings \> Configuration \> Services \> Login as Customer \> Enable Remote Shopping Assistance  
* **Options**:  
  * **Enable Remote Shopping Assistance**: Must be set to "Yes" to activate the feature.  
  * **Shopping Assistance Checkbox Title**: The customizable label displayed next to the customer-facing consent checkbox.  
  * **Shopping Assistance Checkbox Tooltip**: The customizable tooltip text that provides assistance information.
